Episode Description

Episode 198: In this episode of Critical Thinking - Bug Bounty Podcast we're back with the spookiest bug stories we've had this year. We're talking government hacks, summoning global agents, low payouts/long triage times, and possibly the scariest thing of all for us: Dealing with JD's technical issues...
